label: Colour flood
description: A coloured dot drops into place and FLOODS the whole frame -- the scene turns that colour and names it ("#BC361B / Search by color.") -- then can pull back into the dot and vanish. A beat change made from an object on screen, not a cut (the Cosmos search-by-colour beat). Full-frame, above the scene. Label ink is picked for contrast. Example: {"color":"#BC361B","from_y":0.08,"at":0.3,"label":"#BC361B","sublabel":"Search by color.","retract_at":2.8}.

x.label: Where the dot lands and floods from, fraction of width (default 0.5)

from_x.label: Where the dot starts (default: above its mark)

from_y.label: Where the dot starts, fraction of height (e.g. the search chip's height)

dot_size.label: Dot diameter as a fraction of the width (default 0.009)

label.label: Big text on the flood (e.g. the hex)

label_at.label: When the text focuses in (default just after the flood)

label_size.label: Label size as a fraction of the width (default 0.075)

ink.label: Text colour override (default: white or near-black by contrast)

retract_at.label: When the flood pulls back into the dot and vanishes (omit to hold)
